edition.locus: Eusebius HE 5.1.29-31 (the devil's prison devices; the wounded live, the untried die)

source_text: Καταργηθέντων δὲ τῶν τυραννικῶν κολαστηρίων ὑπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ διὰ τῆς τῶν μακαρίων ὑπομονῆς, ἑτέρας μηχανὰς ὁ διάβολος ἐπενόει, τὰς κατὰ τὴν εἱρκτὴν ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ τῷ χαλεπωτάτῳ χωρίῳ συγκλείσεις καὶ τὰς ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ διατάσεις τῶν ποδῶν, ἐπὶ πέμπτον διατεινομένων τρύπημα, καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς αἰκίας, ὅσας εἰώθασιν ὀργιζόμενοι ὑπουργοὶ καὶ ταῦτα διαβόλου πλήρεις διατιθέναι τοὺς ἐγκλειομένους· ὥστε ἀποπνιγῆναι τοὺς πλείστους ἐν τῇ εἱρκτῇ, ὅσους γε ὁ κύριος οὕτως ἐξελθεῖν ἠθέλησεν, ἐπιδεικνὺς τὴν αὐτοῦ δόξαν. Οἱ μὲν γὰρ βασανισθέντες πικρῶς ὥστε δοκεῖν μηδὲ τῆς πάσης θεραπείας τυχόντας ἔτι ζῆσαι δύνασθαι, παρέμενον ἐν τῇ εἱρκτῇ, ἔρημοι μὲν τῆς παρὰ ἀνθρώπων ἐπιμελείας, ἀναρρωννύμενοι δὲ ὑπὸ κυρίου καὶ ἐνδυναμούμενοι καὶ σώματι καὶ ψυχῇ καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς παρορμῶντες καὶ παραμυθούμενοι· οἱ δὲ νεαροὶ καὶ ἄρτι συνειλημμένοι, ὧν μὴ προκατήχιστο τὰ σώματα, τὸ βάρος οὐκ ἔφερον τῆς συγκλείσεως, ἀλλ᾽ ἔνδον ἐναπέθνησκον.
pass_a_gloss: And the tyrannical punishments having been made inoperative by Christ through the endurance of the blessed ones, the devil was contriving other devices: the lockings-up in the prison in the darkness and in the most grievous place, and the stretchings of the feet in the wood, being stretched to the fifth hole, and the remaining torments, as many as angry attendants, and these full of the devil, are accustomed to impose on the shut-in ones; so that the most were choked in the prison, as many indeed as the Lord willed to go out in this way, showing forth his own glory. For on the one hand those having been tortured bitterly so as to seem, even having obtained all healing, still to be no longer able to live, were remaining in the prison, bereft on the one hand of the care from men, but on the other hand being restored by the Lord and being strengthened both in body and in soul, and both urging on and consoling the rest; but on the other hand the youthful and just now arrested ones, whose bodies had not been previously hardened, were not bearing the weight of the confinement, but were dying within.
pass_b_english: When Christ had brought the tyrannical instruments of punishment to nothing through the steadfast endurance of the blessed, the devil devised other contrivances: confinement in the prison, in darkness and in a most grievous place, and the stretching of their feet in the stocks, drawn out as far as the fifth hole, together with the rest of the cruelties that wrathful attendants, themselves full of the devil, habitually inflict upon those locked inside. As a result most were suffocated in the prison, all those whom the Lord willed to depart in this way, and in them he displayed his own glory.

For those who had been tortured bitterly, so bitterly that they seemed unable to go on living even if they received every care, remained in the prison; bereft of any care from men, they were restored by the Lord and strengthened in both body and soul, and they urged on and comforted the rest. But the young, those only just arrested and whose bodies had not been hardened beforehand, could not bear the weight of the confinement, and they died inside.

lemmas.gloss: stretchings on the rack or stocks

choices.why: genitive absolute aorist passive participle; context is Christ nullifying prior tortures through endurance, not merely ending them administratively
ξύλον here is the prison foot-stock, paired with stretching of the feet, not wood in general

choices.english: drawn out as far as the fifth hole
choices.why: genitive of feet extended to the farthest pin-hole, meaning maximal distension; πέμπτον is ordinal marking degree of stretching
